g.text: Fig. 6. Comparative Analysis of Adaptive, Fixed
(a) Salinity Tracking: The adaptive STR converges to the 1.0% target, whereas the open
loop (OL) and fixed PID methods fail to reach the target due to unmodeled ingredient
effects. (b) Measured Conductivity: Sensor responses across the three different control
strategies. (c) Control Input (Salt): Cumulative salt added; the STR dynamically adjusts
the dosage to compensate for environmental changes, unlike the static OL and PID. (d)
actual physical properties of the soup.
